collocations: political/religious/party dogma：政治/宗教/政党信条
words.etymology: “a settled opinion, a principle held as being firmly established,” c. 1600 (in plural dogmata), from Latin dogma “philosophical tenet,” from Greek dogma (genitive dogmatos) “opinion, tenet,” literally “that which one thinks is true”.
words.mnemonic: dog-（=doc-：教）+ -ma（表行为结果的名词后缀）→教导的结果→

words.definition: 自以为是的；教条的；武断的
examples:
There is a danger of becoming too dogmatic about teaching methods.
在教学方法上存在着过分教条主义的危险。
words.mnemonic: dogma（教条）+ -atic（形容词后缀）→教条的；武断的
